This TV\'s Wi-Fi was saved by its setup wizard. The new home screen needs the wizard off, which would forget the Wi-Fi, and with the wizard left on the TV can crash. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking. To swap it later, forget and re-add the network in Settings, or use a cable, then run Setup again.

This TV\'s Wi-Fi was saved by its setup wizard, and we don\'t know this TV well enough yet to switch the wizard off safely. With the wizard left on, a new home screen can crash the TV, so it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

We couldn\'t check who saved this TV\'s Wi-Fi. The new home screen needs the setup wizard off, which could forget the Wi-Fi, and with the wizard left on the TV can crash. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

On this Google device the new home screen needs the setup wizard off, and without it casting from phones stops working after every restart. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

On this TV family the setup wizard comes back at every restart, and with the TV\'s own home screen off that can stop the TV starting up. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

On this TV the remote\'s app buttons (Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video and YouTube Music) only work through its own home screen. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

We don\'t know this TV well enough to switch its setup wizard off, and with the wizard left on and the TV\'s own home screen off, the TV can crash. So it keeps its own home screen. We\'ll still switch off the adverts and tracking.

The old home screen is back

If the TV is stuck on its logo: hold the power button on the TV itself (not the remote) for 10 seconds, then turn it on again. If it shows a screen that says \"Can\'t load Android system\", choose Try again. Don\'t choose factory reset; it isn\'t needed.
As soon as the TV is back on Wi-Fi we\'ll reconnect and put the old home screen back automatically, so you can decide what to do calmly.
